DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_BrownRabbit:
While in party,
increases the player's Defense and Movement Speed by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> while sprinting, increases the player's movement speed by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue2}%</>, increases the player's melee attack speed by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue3}%</>, and reduces the player's stamina consumption by <Status_Up>{Passive2_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)
